title: LLM-Enhanced Semantic Analysis for Insider Threat Detection in Enterprise Communication Logs

contributions.purpose: 提出对齐SOC三级分诊的两阶段anomaly+semantics流水线
contributions.mechanism: Stage-1全量行为异常过滤,Stage-2仅对top风险子集做LLM语义复审生成SOC叙事
contributions.domain: 内部威胁检测/企业安全
contributions.source_quote: A two-stage anomaly+semantics pipeline aligned with practical SOC triage: scalable filtering first, then focused high-fidelity review

contributions.purpose: 在CERT全量语料上给出透明特征工程与混合风险评分
contributions.mechanism: 连续特征+二元风险flag+OCEAN心理测量先验+Isolation Forest,z-归一化合成风险分
contributions.evaluation: 覆盖~2.63M邮件/~1k用户;二元特征2-5×分离(如off-hour 42% vs 19%)
contributions.source_quote: A transparent feature engineering and hybrid risk-scoring recipe on the full CERT corpus, including user-level psychometrics

contributions.purpose: 论证语义复审补充数字过滤并产生可审计理由
contributions.mechanism: 对top风险邮件构造结构化prompt让LLM生成意图叙事
contributions.evaluation: 代理标签子集(200正/200负)分类ROC-AUC 0.92-0.96,称叙事提升分析师覆盖~10-20%
contributions.source_quote: Empirical evidence that semantic review complements numeric filtering by surfacing intent signals and producing human-readable justifications

self_declared_provenance.quote: Recent work advocates hybrid architectures—first narrowing the candidate set via statistical filters, then applying semantic review to a manageable subset [15,6]. Our work explicitly operationalizes this hybrid approach

notes: 重大数据可信度红旗:(1)ROC-AUC 0.92-0.96为循环论证——正/负标签由同一混合风险分的极端分位数派生,再用该分数当特征分类,tautological;(2)Table1 prevalence标注'estimated',非真实标注,作者自认labels为proxy、numbers仅sanity check;(3)表格编号混乱(正文引Table 8/6/7但实际仅Table1-4,且Table3重复出现两次);(4)6.3'Ablations'段落与6.2逐字重复(占位/未写);(5)'覆盖提升10-20%'无任何测量支撑。合成CERT数据。AI披露:假设/实验设计/数据分析/写作全部[D](AI生成),人类仅提示与复审。desk-reject级。
